title: Select and append an SVG shape
summary: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes.
introduction: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes. Your task: Change the circle radius to 40.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for select and append an svg shape

blocks.text: A D3 selection points to page elements. append creates a child element, and attr sets one of its attributes.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Select and append an SVG shape

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: Appending svg creates the drawing area; appending circle creates one shape inside it.
cx and cy set the circle centre, while r sets its radius in SVG units.

blocks.text: A navy circle appears at x=80, y=80 with radius 30.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: SVG uses its own shape attributes such as cx and r. They are not ordinary CSS margin values.
